title: im feeling so depressed because i did not got job

messages.text: im feeling so depressed because i did not got job

I am so sorry you're going through this. Job searching can be incredibly stressful, and dealing with rejection hurts deeply. It is completely understandable that you are feeling down right now. 

Please remember that not getting a job offer isn't a reflection of your true worth, talent, or potential. Finding the right opportunity often takes time, especially when transitioning from college into the job market. 

Take a moment to be gentle with yourself today. Give yourself permission to rest and process how you feel. You don't have to figure everything out all at once. I'm here for you if you'd like to talk through it or vent.
